answers.core: It seems fairly core to the functionality of the SpriteFrames, as well as the fact that a similar functionality is already present in another part (TextureRegions) of the game.
answers.workaround: I suspect that this feature will be used quite frequently. It would likely be the more convenient way to slice the spritesheets for SpriteFrames, as well as offering more niche functionality for developers that use spritesheets with separation/an offset.
